[P2] Reconsider the untested optional callback path

This optional call introduces a branch for an absent `configurationWarning`, but both `registerTools` and the test helper always provide the callback. Returning `undefined` from that callback does not exercise its absence, so no behavioral test requires the optional-call guard. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6; a simpler dependency contract could omit this unused optional behavior.
